subject: Vulnerability evidence transmission and SLA acknowledgement
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintegrate.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintegrate.com
Date: 2026-05-10T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evidence set for VM cadence + SLA + CVE remediation for integration

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Our InfoSec team requested a compact evidence packet for our SOC 2 / SIG review of the Redwood integration. Could you please provide the following by COB May 18?

- Scan cadence (tooling, scope, and last 60 days of scan results)
- SLA commitments for vulnerability triage and remediation (definitions for P1/P2/P3 and associated timelines)
- Proof of remediation or compensating controls for active CVEs impacting our integration (top 5/highest risk items)
- A signed attestation from the responsible engineering lead confirming the above

If possible, include a short runbook that shows how you route and escalate findings for third-party/partner-impacting issues. We want something concise we can attach to our SIG questionnaire.

Appreciate it — let me know if that timeline is realistic.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen
Security Program Manager, Fintegrate
alice.chen@fintegrate.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintegrate.com>
Cc: security@fintegrate.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence set for VM cadence + SLA + CVE remediation for integration

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear ask.

We can deliver a compact evidence packet by May 15 (earlier than your requested date) with the items you listed. Outline below:

1) Scan cadence + scope: will include our weekly authenticated + unauthenticated vulnerability scan window, monthly dependency SBOM scan, and weekly container image scans.
2) SLA definitions: P1 (prod-exploitable) 72-hour ack, 14-day mitigation plan; P2 7-day ack, 30-day remediation; P3 routine backlog.
3) Remediation proof: for each active CVE we will attach scan snapshots, PR/CL references with patch commits, and verification logs.
4) Attestation: I will sign and provide a PDF attestation from Redwood engineering stating these commitments.

Attached to this email is an initial runbook (runbook_vm_playbook.pdf) and a short CSV export of scan cadence (scan_cadence_log_20260501-20260514.csv) that shows the last two weeks.

I have looped in Monica (ops) and Ben (security engineering) to prepare the remediation summary and the signed attestation. Monica/Ben — can you own the cve_remediation_summary_20260515.xlsx and the signed_attestation_neha_kapoor.pdf? Target to me by EOD May 14 so I can review and send to Fintegrate on the 15th.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Fintegrate evidence pack — tasks and artifacts

Monica / Ben — quick internal plan and owners. Per Alice's ask, keep artifacts concise; Fintegrate prefers an audit-friendly packet (one ZIP, clear index).

Artifacts to assemble:
- cve_remediation_summary_20260515.xlsx (Ben) — sheet per CVE with: CVE id, affected component, severity, discovery date, PR/commit link, deploy date, verification log snippet, mitigation status.
- signed_attestation_neha_kapoor.pdf (Neha/Ben) — short one-paragraph attestation + signature block. I will sign; Ben prepare DocuSign if needed.
- runbook_vm_playbook.pdf (done) — already attached to external reply.
- scan_cadence_log_20260501-20260514.csv (Monica) — include tooling, scan schedule, and a sample of failures -> triage tickets.

Ops timeline:
- Today (May 12): Ben starts CVE list and links; Monica exports scan logs.
- May 13: Draft remediation sheet to me for technical validation.
- May 14 (EOD): Final artifacts to me. I will sign and prepare one ZIP and a short cover email.

Remember: redact any internal-only ticket IDs and include only the public-facing proof (commit IDs, ticket summary not internal commentary). Keep everything in the evidence folder (Drive link below) and mark file names exactly as the list.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-vm-evidence
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/put/abc123-attestation

Thanks — Neha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintegrate.com>
Cc: security@fintegrate.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverable: Fintegrate VM evidence packet + signed attestation

Hi Alice — per our timeline, attached is the compact evidence packet for your SOC 2 / SIG review. Files included in the ZIP and linked Drive folder:

- runbook_vm_playbook.pdf (overview of scanning, triage flow, escalation matrix)
- scan_cadence_log_20260501-20260514.csv (authenticated/unauthenticated scans, tool versions, scope)
- cve_remediation_summary_20260515.xlsx (summary for top 5 active CVEs impacting partner integrations)
- signed_attestation_neha_kapoor.pdf (Engineer lead attestation)

Summary highlights:
- Scan cadence: weekly full infrastructure scans; container image checks on CI pipelines on every build; dependency SBOM checks on merge.
- SLA: P1 72h ack / 14-day mitigation plan; P2 7d ack / 30d mitigation; P3 scheduled remediation windows (next sprint).
- Top CVEs: for each CVE we provide the detection snapshot, PR/commit link, the release version, and a validation log showing the vulnerability no longer reproduces in our environment. See sheet rows 2-6 in the attached XLSX.

If you need a notarized or vendor-specific form of attestation, Ben has prepared a DocuSign envelope (link below) that I have signed electronically.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-vm-evidence
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/put/abc123-attestation

Let me know if you want any of the artifacts split out differently for your SIG response.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
